headlines.description: Hearts will have to avoid defeat away to Celtic on Saturday in order to win the William Hill Premiership title after a 3-0 home win over depleted Falkirk maintained their one-point advantage at the top.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hearts maintain title edge heading into final day

headlines.description: Kelechi Iheanacho scored a VAR-assisted penalty winner nine minutes into stoppage-time to boost Celtic 's Premiership defence thanks to a 3-2 comeback win at Motherwell as the most dramatic title race in decades took another sensational twist.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtic keep title hopes alive with last-gasp winner

headlines.description: Rangers' post-split collapse continued with a 2-1 defeat against Hibernian amid controversy surrounding captain James Tavernier's role at his Ibrox send-off.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers continue losing streak, Tavernier out

headlines.description: Celtic dashed Hearts' Scottish Premiership dreams in dramatic fashion as Daizen Maeda's late VAR-assisted winner helped the hosts secure a 3-1 victory in the title decider.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtic stun Hearts late to clinch Scottish title
